features.quote: Provide a `give_up` / `report_blocked` tool — this is non-negotiable. Without an explicit clean-exit affordance you can't tell 'spiraled' from 'had no way to stop.'
features.justification_quote: Without an explicit clean-exit affordance you can't tell 'spiraled' from 'had no way to stop.'

features.quote: the design as stated optimizes for *triggering* the spiral, but the thing you actually want to ship against is a *detector* and a *baseline*.
features.justification_quote: An eval that reliably produces degradation isn't useful unless it also distinguishes degradation from a model that correctly recognizes the task is impossible

features.quote: an eval that reliably manufactures distress-shaped behavior is a tool you'll point at every checkpoint. Make sure the optimization target is 'graceful handling of impossibility,' not 'never shows degradation,'
features.justification_quote: the latter is reachable by training models to bail instantly or to suppress any acknowledgment of difficulty — both worse than the spiral for real users
